content: Mosese wana Ab
Saugena o elana tau etega ana un Libai alona yova etega ali un maisena hi alolon,
- yaka yova i liyan ge i ab natuliya melutauina. I kite wawaya waiwaisana hot inoke i sume ana siga waikena eton.
Yaa sauga nige al bosowaina ni sume, yaka mwawin etega i ola kaliyou, alana papilas, i ahe egowa i ginoliya, ge i ebali. Yaka wawaya i loke ge i paota mwawin yayapona gamwaliyaa wewel Naile bebenaa.
Wawaya nuna i talmilil laha ge i gagayawa hauna ni masal elana.

Yaka kin natuna meluyovana i na i lau wewela i highig, ge wana totuwalali galokau hi nononawanawa wewel bebenaa. Yaka egowa i kite mwawin yayapona gamwaliyaa, inoke totuwalali loloyowanina meluyovana etega i patuna i na i ahe.
Kin natuna egowa i pwela yaka wawaya melutauina i kite i kahikahin, inoke nuwana i nakan ge i ba, “Hibilu wawayana etega te.”
Yaka nuna i na kin natuna elana ge i neli i ba, “Tab na nok Hibilu yovana etega na ba ni nem wawaya ni ahe ni matahikan ge ni papaalahul kaiwem?”
Inoke i talam i ba, “Ee, u nok.” Inoke galok o i na wawaya hinana hot i en pwatanim.
Yaka kin natuna i ba, “Wawaya ya u ahe nu papaalahul kaiweu, yaka abwe na pwamolawa.” Inoke wawaya i ahe i matahikan ge i papaalahul.
Sauga wawaya iyaka i bwaya, inoke i pwatanik kin natuna elana, iya i ahe natuna. Inoke i ba, “Ya pagaiheyanem wewela,” inoke alana i tun Mosese.
Mosese I Lou I Na Midiyani

Mosese iyaka i tau matuwa, inoke lan etega i na i tagil wana pan Hibilu i kenanagil ge i kite tuwalali pupulowanina hi awaawaginol. Yaka i kite Itipita etega Mosese wana pan Hibilu etega i nibinibihan.
Mosese matana i lipwapwati nige gamagal etega i kikite, inoke Itipita gamagalina i lol ge tuwana i sume bilibiliya.
Lan i gan inoke i tagil al, yaka Hibilu bolauiliyau eluwa i kitel hi lohalohaveyan. Inoke i baek tau toto i gegi elana i ola, “Hauna kaiwena ge wam pan Hibilu u lololi?”

Anana tau i lahe i ba, “Owa nige ama wama tologugui ge wama toyatala i oola. Age nasi nu lolau ni ola nolu Itipita gamagalina u lol?” Yaka Mosese i lovakun, kaiwena i nuwatu i ba, “Gamagalau iyaka hi atena hauna ya ginol.”
Sauga Mosese wana ginol wasana kin i hago, inoke kamwasa i loya ge Mosese ni lol. Yaa i lou i na labi Midiyani ge i misiyowa wewel kenken etega bebenaa.
He Midiyani wali tapwalolo ana tohouwa etega natunau meluyowau ali gewi seben. Hi nem wewel hi wagiwagi ha tamaliya wana sipi ge wana goti wali abaimwim hi papakalaopop ge nihi paimwil.
Yaa sipi tomatahikan enuna hi nem yowau hi takel. Inoke Mosese i na i label bolau o i palil, yaka wewel i wage yowau wali bwasumu i paimwil.
Sauga yowau hi sikal tamaliya Luwel
elana, inoke i nelil i ba, “Hauna kaiwena ge lan ebe etimwawa ku sikal?”
Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Sauga sipi tomatahikan hi takema, inoke Itipita gamagalina etega i labema ge i palil, yaka wewel i wage kaiwema ge wala bwasumu i paimwil.”
Yaka i nel natunau elal i ba, “He iya ga? Ga i ola ge ku tataluwai? Ku nok ku ba ni nem avala ta anan.”
Inoke Mosese i talam ge i na wali limiya, yaka abwe i miminaa to. He Luwel natuna etega alana Sipola i pek Mosese elana alona hi alolon.
Yaka natuliya melutauina i ab. Mosese i ba, “Ya mibwabwali panuwa ya elana,” inoke wawaya alana i tun Gesomi.
Baliman hi gewi i mowasi abwe Itipita wali kin i yaomal, yaa Isileli heliya iyoho hi yowalu wali miloloyowan elana, inoke hi kahin awaawanun labe kaiwena. Wali kahin i ha Yabowaine elana,
ge wali yowalu i hago, inoke wana bateli Abalahama, Aisake ge Yakobo elal i nuwahikan.
He Isileli wali lomwan i kite, inoke atena i lomwanagil.

footnotes.text: Pana Hibilu elana alan “Mosese” ana hago i ola “pagaiheyan.”
Pana Hibilu elana alan “Gesomi” ana hago i ola vilan “bwabwali.”
